MaaS360 sales guide — section 1

Prospecting

Two ways to build a list of real MaaS360 accounts. One leans on AI and ZoomInfo for volume, the other leans on LinkedIn Sales Navigator for quality. Pick a lane below — every step, prompt, and screenshot you need is in it.

UPDATED JUN 17, 2026

Good for covering a lot of ground fast. An AI tool researches 50 real, mid-market companies that fit MaaS360's profile, then ZoomInfo's List Match turns that list into searchable contacts.

01
Open your AI tool

Copy the prospecting prompt

Paste this into Claude (or whatever AI you use) and swap in your territory before sending.

💡You can freely adjust the number of prospects, fit criteria, territory, and anything else in the prompt — this is just a starting point.
AI prompt
You are an expert enterprise sales researcher with deep knowledge of IBM MaaS360, a Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) and Mobile Device Management(MDM) platform.

Your task is to identify 50 REAL companies that are strong MaaS360 prospects for a seller operating in the following territory. If territory is not provided, ask the respondent for their specific territory before generating contacts:

TERRITORY: [Insert Territory Here]

These must be real, verifiable companies that actually exist — not fictional or AI generated placeholders. If you cannot generate 50 contacts, notify the user and research what you can. Think like a researcher who knows the local business landscape.

MAAS360 FIT CRITERIA (every company must meet at least one):
- Has a distributed or mobile workforce (field technicians, delivery drivers, sales reps, nurses, inspectors, contractors, etc.)
- Operates under a compliance mandate (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, CMMC, FINRA, etc.)
- Is scaling and likely outgrowing basic or no device management
- Is known to use a legacy or competing MDM (Intune, Jamf, Workspace ONE) and may be open to switching OR does not have one yet.

TARGET INDUSTRIES:
Healthcare, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Logistics/Transportation, Insurance, Legal, Retail with field teams, Government Contractors, Education, Professional Services

OUTPUT FORMAT:
Return a downloadable CSV with exactly 50 rows (not a copy and pastable one), each row being a contact. Include header row.

Columns should be in this exact order:
Company URL, Company Name, City, State, Industry

RULES:
- Company Name must be the real, official business name
- Company Size should be an employee range (e.g. 200-500)
- Headquarters City should reflect the territory provided
- MaaS360 Fit Reason must be specific — explain exactly why this company needs MDM/UEM (tie to their industry, workforce type, compliance exposure, or known tech stack)
- Do not include Fortune 500 or large enterprise companies — focus on mid-market (100–5,000 employees)
- Do not add any explanation, preamble, or notes — return only the CSV
02
Open your AI tool

Download the CSV it returns

You should get back exactly 50 rows — Company URL, Company Name, City, State, Industry — with no extra commentary. Download it as a file rather than copying the text.

03
Open ZoomInfo

Start a new list

In ZoomInfo, click Lists and Records in the left sidebar, then Lists on the right, then Upload Lists.

04
Open ZoomInfo

Choose Companies → ListMatch

Select Companies as the list type and ListMatch as the action, then click Next.

05
Open ZoomInfo

Upload the actual CSV file

Click Upload CSV and select the file you downloaded.

⚠️Don't paste the CSV as text — uploading a copy-pasted version instead of the file itself will map the columns incorrectly.
06
Open ZoomInfo

Confirm the field mapping

ZoomInfo auto-maps Company URL, Company Name, City, State, and Industry. Everything should already read "Mapped" — check it, then click Submit.

07
Open ZoomInfo

Open your matched list

Not every company will match a ZoomInfo record — that's normal. Click Open List, then Open in Company Search or Open in Contact Search to see the full list.

Takes longer, but you're hand-picking real people on LinkedIn rather than matching a generated company list — leads tend to be warmer and better targeted.

—
Prerequisite

Install the ZoomInfo Chrome extension

You'll need this later in the workflow to pull selected LinkedIn contacts into ZoomInfo. Grab it from the Chrome Web Store now so it's ready.

01
Open your AI tool

Ask AI to build your Boolean search

Claude is recommended, though Copilot works too. Paste the prompt below and fill in your own targeting details.

💡Adjust the number of prospects, criteria, and other specifics freely — this is a starting template.
AI prompt
I work at IBM selling MaaS360, which is an MDM/UEM (Mobile Device Management / Unified Endpoint Management) solution. I need help building a Boolean search string and filter settings for LinkedIn Sales Navigator to find good prospects. Here is my situation:

Target industries: [e.g. Healthcare, Financial Services, Government, Retail, Manufacturing, Education — or specify yours]
Target company size: [e.g. 200–2,000 employees / Mid-market]
Territory/Geography: [e.g. Texas, Midwest, Northeast — or specify yours]
Competitor focus: [e.g. target users of Intune, Jamf, Workspace ONE — or say "any competitor is fine"]
Seniority I want to reach: [e.g. Director, VP, C-Level, Manager]

Please give me:
1. A Boolean keyword string I can paste directly into the LinkedIn Sales Navigator keyword search bar
2. A list of recommended filters to stack on top (seniority, headcount, industry, geography, etc.)
3. A step-by-step instructions for applying these in Sales Navigator correctly so company size filters work properly
4. Any tips specific to selling MDM/UEM solutions like MaaS360
02
Open your AI tool

Take the four things it hands back

  1. A Boolean keyword string for the Sales Navigator search bar
  2. Recommended filters to stack on top (seniority, headcount, industry, geography)
  3. Step-by-step instructions so company-size filters apply correctly
  4. Tips specific to selling MDM/UEM
03
Open LinkedIn Sales Navigator

Paste the keyword string into Lead search

Open Sales Navigator search, click Lead, then the search bar, and paste your string. Here's an example:

Example keyword string
("MDM" OR "UEM" OR "mobile device management" OR "unified endpoint management" OR "endpoint management" OR "device management" OR "Intune" OR "Jamf" OR "Workspace ONE" OR "MobileIron" OR "Ivanti" OR "Mosyle" OR "Hexnode") AND ("IT" OR "information technology" OR "cybersecurity" OR "information security" OR "infrastructure" OR "endpoint security" OR "CISO" OR "CIO" OR "CTO")

Stack geography, function, and other filters on the left to keep narrowing.

04
Optional

Layer on a subfilter

A subfilter is your own extra pass on top of Sales Navigator's results. Feed the list to an AI tool and ask it to flag people in a more specific role — cybersecurity or IT, for example — then paste those tags into a filter like Current Job Title.

💡This narrows an already-filtered list without needing Sales Navigator to have a built-in filter for that exact criteria.
Example subfilter tags
"Chief Information Officer" OR "CIO" OR "CISO" OR "IT Director" OR "Director of Information Services" OR "Director of Information Technology" OR "IT Manager" OR "Network Administrator" OR "Systems Engineer" OR "Deputy CIO" OR "Chief Technology Officer" OR "Director of Cybersecurity" OR "IT Security Manager"
05
Open LinkedIn Sales Navigator

Select contacts, page by page

Click the checkmark in the top-left to select everyone on the page, then click the red ZoomInfo icon on the right side of the page. If it doesn't appear, refresh the page or clear your cookies.

⚠️Selecting only works one page at a time — there's no mass-select option.
06
ZoomInfo sidebar

Uncheck anyone opted out

A ZoomInfo panel opens in the sidebar. Go through the contacts and uncheck anyone tagged "Opted out of ZoomInfo" before exporting.

07
ZoomInfo sidebar

Export to SalesLoft, or your platform of choice

Scroll up, open the Export dropdown, and send the list to SalesLoft or wherever you run your sequences.
